race.comment: CELESTIAL STARLET (6) is stepping out for the first time. By Poster Boy and hails from the T J Hutchins stable. Was not far away in a recent trial. Will be right there at the business end. MISS CULLEN (7) finished seventh last start over 2240m at Swan Hill, beaten 85 metres, after a good second at this track the run prior. Should enjoy a nice smother from this draw and will be looking for a split at some stage. Leading hope if things go her way. FEARLESS SNIPER (1) didn't do a bad job when sixth over 2190m at this track last time out. THE MIGHTY CAESAR (3) is stepping out for the first time. By Caesar Augustus and hails from the B I Devcic stable. Has the benefit of a good draw. Will be right there at the business end.
